Muckshake

Type: Food | Internal ID: ShocklateSmoothie | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Ooze x1, Raspberries x2, Blueberries x2 | Max Health: 16 | Max Stamina: 50 | Duration: 20m | Healing: 1 hp/tick

Introduction. Muckshake is a Swamp-tier food.

Recipe. Muckshake is produced in a level 2 Cauldron with:
• 2 Blueberries
• 1 Ooze
• 2 Raspberries

Notes. • Muckshake provides the second highest stamina gain in the Swamps at 50, second to Turnip stew at 55.
